comment: Best day for this trail. There were no bugs until we got to the road and then the deer flies were vicious. Drape up!!
Liked the first half more than the second. Kinda buggy near the end

Nice trail around the lake but not a lot of good view points and if you’re doing the circle you have to walk for about 1km on the road at the end. Great conditions though, dog friendly, and some nice wildlife.

Well Maintained trails and easy to navigate. Good signage. Interesting mushrooms.
Lovely cottages nestled in the woods not to many mosquitos!
Nice little walk , we took our time nothing too strenuous. A few bugs but not too bad . Passed maybe 5-6 groups very quiet

This hike was amazing! Definitely recommend hiking shoes as there are lots of roots and rocks exposed. The hike up echo rock to see the lookout is very steep especially while carrying a toddler in a backpack carrier but was a great view. A few trees down on the trail we had to duck under or go over them. Bugs were out so also recommend bug spray. Also as mentioned in some previous reviews, you do walk through some private cottage waterfront properties but a few property owners were out when we passed through and were very friendly!

I personally wouldn’t say this was moderate but quite easy. There was only one true hill before echo cliff. The lookout was very small, but beautiful. The bugs were there, but I coated well in bug spray and they weren’t too bad. The downside was the trail takes you through the waterfront of residents private areas, felt a little intrusive. But the rest was very private. Basically had it to myself!

We went in the morning and had the trail pretty much to ourselves. Bugs aren’t awful but I would recommend bug spray, because they were annoying (mainly in the middle of the hike). Really pretty hike through the forest, lookout isn’t all that though, it’s high up but nothing special.
The AllTrails route makes no sense. Why would you walk along the road and over the lake. I am not Jesus. Take the solitude trail around the lake which is very nice.
Fun little trail for a quick hike. Mosquitoes were bad near the parking area, but disappeared along the trail, for the most part.
Signage up front is unclear. Paths are thru private property so can feel intrusive. Bring bug spray.
Easy well maintained and marked trail.
It rained the day before so parts of the trails were super muddy the mosquitoes are out something fierce. Great views & dog friendly.
Monday morning hike so there wasn’t anyone else on the trail
No bugs today but probably will be before too long. Too many off leash dogs with owners nowhere in sight.
First hike of 2026. Well maintained. Went with family and enjoyed the scenery! The water was crystal clear
Algonquin without the addmission

Amazing hike, very easy for 90% of it. 1 steep incline and decline around echo hill. The views are outstanding. 

Came around 10:30am on a Monday and  we had the entire trail to ourselves. 

The lookout was small BUT could definitely fit 4 people. Great place for a quick sit down snack or drink. The trail ends on the main road and you have to walk up to the parking lot.
A little muddy at points, but clearly marked.
If you start the loop counter clockwise the trail snakes up to the lookout. If you start clockwise it is a sharper more direct incline.
Sunny, cold beautiful day! My first time in Limberlost Forest. Will comeback in summer or fall.
Great trail with beautiful snow all around
Engaged!!!
Lots of snow!

The trail was very icy in many places. Grippers/icers and poles are advised. It was better as the day warmed up. It’s a beautiful trail for scenery and most of the time you are hiking alongside the lake. Loved the boardwalk stretches over the lake.
Amazing view!! Really well kept
A nice Autumn walk through the forest. Falls colours have finished up here.

2 hour fall hike on a Monday. Passed only a few groups of people early on route. Was glad that we started the hike going clockwise so we ended at Echo Rock. Only a few inclines and descents, otherwise a mostly flat hike.

The main loop is about 6km but feel free to explore the side trails, which are quieter. Dog friendly yes, but absolutely need to be on a leash. Please respect the private cottages the trail passes through.
Fantastic hike of Solitaire Lake to and around Clear Lake. Excellent conditions

An absolutely gorgeous walk around the lake.  Beautiful boardwalks over the water, interesting rock  formations, lovely views.  Very well maintained trail conditions.  It would be a must repeat when I return to the area.
those who missed the chance to have a permit to Au
Great hiking. One point up and down a hill. Amazing view of the leafs. We took breaks. Walked slow. Completed the whole loop in 2 hours…mind you, at a slow pace.
Easy to follow paths. Kind of the same scenery on most of the trail. Has some nice spots.
Great hike, not too difficult. Nice view. Gorgeous in autumn.
Generally easy to moderate. There were some very steep parts
Beautiful fall colours along the lake. There is a lot of tree roots so just be careful. Also the leaves cover up the trail, it could be hard to get off trail but the markings on the trees help.
Beautiful trail,,with lots of side trails you could add on! Definitely need proper shoes. It’s pretty rooted along the trail. I didn’t find it muddy or needed bug spray! Must see in October
Great variety of terrain. Woods, boardwalk, lookouts.
Beautiful views around the lake, mostly shaded trail,  clearly marked and easy to follow.
Most of tbe trail is flat, not too rocky, and not too rooty. The trail to the lookout is very steep but worth the. climb.
Beautiful trail , well maintained and marked.
Beautiful full colors. Great views of the lake.
Absolutely awesome!!!

Very pretty fall walk. You see water and forest while walking along. You should  be careful as it’s almost completely tree roots you are walking on but it’s fairly easy.  Easy to follow. One major incline but not too difficult.  We had beautiful weather which made it especially nice.
Nice walk around the lake. A bit of an incline and decline in one spot but otherwise pretty easy walk.
Trail in excellent shape as usual. Saw pair of loons in Solitaire Lake. Fall colour change well established.

Enjoyed this loop trail. Cute boardwalks and some great views. As others mentioned the only downfall is the section where you pass through a lot of
Cottages. Once you’re past it’s very private and peaceful.
Good trail. Well groomed and easy to follow. Lots of different trail options so you can customize how long you want to hike for.
Lovely easy hike! Beautiful views.
classic trail at limberlost, a must see!!

Great hike around the lake. 8.02 km not 6.3 km. Lots of foot bridges and look outs. You walk across the front of cottages in the beginning but great views. The rock face is amazing and the view from the top is equally beautiful. The steep hike up to the view is worth it though.

This is a great trail. It stays very close to the lake for the most part. It's also mostly flat and has some beautiful forest scenery. I liked it more than the Algonquin trails as it feels less isolated. It took me about 2.5 hours.
Great trail! Clean and well maintained, makes for a great morning walk.
Lake Solitaire August 31st 2025

Used to be open now it’s highly regulated, signage everywhere, they don’t want anyone seeing a sunrise or sunset there anymore 9-5 only with a bunch of paperwork first.  Other than one viewpoint trail is nothing special.  Even though signage says you are in J Albert Bauer Provincial Park… you are somehow also in Limberlost and they fuelling their egos with control and signage.
Trail is in good condition with no bugs. The trail is easy with one hill to the viewpoint.
Walked clockwise around solitaire and then at the final gate joined turtle to the car park. Awesome walk
Trail takes an upwards turn near Quartz rock
This trail was beautiful- lots steep areas we were fine but my dad had a tough time. Use caution if you have limited mobility.

Couldn’t find the start of the trail originally, but was able to get onto the trail and really enjoyed the scenery. Only saw 2 birds and squirrels, no other wildlife the entire time. The views were amazing, barely any bugs yesterday.
Well marked. Small trails that leak together to give you the length you want.  No real picnic spots.

It was a good hike.  We took our time taking pictures and enjoying the scenery.  Two parts of the trail had a hard time finding the markings but the rest was very well marked.  Went past some cottages and the last part was on the road, but overall it was a great hike.
excellent trail. beautiful views. watch for different birds of prey along the way.
The last part of this trail is on the road leading to the park entrance.
We really enjoyed this trail. It’s not overly challenging and it’s quite rewarding in terms of views. We hit the trail relatively early, around 9:30-10 and it wasn’t too crowded thankfully.

Great trail. A lot of roots and rocks to watch out for. 15+ boardwalk sections. Some are very short but a few were nice and long. Echo rock lookout is nice. The hike up to the granite rock was a bit sleep for my mother. We had to stop part way up for her. Overall it was a nice trail to walk. Took us 2hours 6mins to walk the 6.5kms.
Well marked,well kept trail right on the water. Nice trek

Really nice, well maintained trail. The trail circles a beautiful lake and offers many places to sit and relax while taking in the view. Amazing smells. 

I’d say the only rather weird thing were the private cottages along the way.
Awesome trail
Hate the end with cottages
The only bad part is that is runs in front of cottages.
Very well maintained trail. The water is crystal clear and warm this time of year. Bring a bathing suit, you’ll want to go in!

Interesting trail.  Could not find the trailhead and only stumbled up the trail after walking through a golf course(?) Snf thanks to All Trails map.  Was very awkward walking in front of private residences on the trail.  Trail was well maintained.  Last stretch on road was not great either.
Amazing trail, amazing views! Moderately challenging trail.
Nice lake trail. Echo rock was a great lookout. Turn at the sign that says quartz deposit as that is where the trail heads up to the high lookout.  Trail was dry today.
Nice, easy trail. Primarily straight the entire time with the exception being the climb to the lookout. Very quiet. A bit awkward to walk in front of cottages but everyone was friendly.
Beautiful hike. Steep climb at one part. Very quiet. Dogs allowed on leash. Have to go by some occupied cabins but not a big deal.
Good trail until we got lost. Stay left at granite deposit trail,  it takes you up the cliff. The water trail ends, this portion was poorly marked.
Great morning hike! Trail was relatively well marked and in good condition. Muddy in some areas. Very quiet and peaceful trail.
Second favourite trail for sure!
Found it moderate, great views, incredible outlook!

Well marked and maintained trail, lots of roots and rocks but not muddy, and relatively flat except for one climb to a quartz outcrop and a beautiful cliff lookout near the end. It took us 1 hour and 50 minutes. The first part of the trail passes between cottages and the lake, but for the rest of it we were completely alone. Very enjoyable hike!
Amazing hiking trail.  Very well maintained but moderate difficulty. Lots of roots and rocks with a couple large elevation changes and great views. Highly recommend
Well maintained and marked trail. Incredible lookout
Gorgeous easy trail. Well marked and not muddy.
Perfect conditions- soft dry ground. Perfect with 4 kids under 9
Great well maintained and marked trail. Follows lake all the way around with good wooden platforms to cross inlets. Small inland loop by Echocall lookout with great views. Highly recommended

An easy trail for beginners and families alike. Lots of bridges to get around big boulders. A few good spots to stop and look around at the look. There is a lookout closer to the end of the trail which is also great. The trail is well maintained and free of any obstructions.

Views along the lake shore were fantastic.
Bug spray would really make a difference
Beautiful hike around the lake. Lots of great views and scenic nature to explore. Muddy in spots. Bring big spray
Great hike, need to watch your steps.
Lake Solitaire with Cole and Lydia June 21st 2026
Def more challenging than I expected with a child and two dogs, but felt good when we were finished .  Beautiful trails.
Lake Solitaire June 13 2025
Beautiful trail. Nice rock formations and boardwalks along the water in a few places. Generally flat except the climb to the lockout. Several cottages on the north east part of the loop.
No wildlife spotted except red squirrels and mosquitoes. Tough trail with some scenic parts.
Beautiful trail that circles the entire lake. A nice breeze and sunny sky today. Boardwalks where muddy but mostly dry. I’ll come again

A little chilly but no issues if you have layers! Ended up taking layer off in the middle of the hike. Fairly flat except for one part. Would say more of an easy hike than moderate. Bugs only at the lookout. Some muddy parts
Lovely trail with tons of diverse views - rocks, streams, lake view and forest! I wouldn’t consider it moderate, there is some incline but the trail is mostly free of trip hazards.
Do the forget mosquito repellent and if possible get those face nets, I forgot bout that lol but someone was nice enough to give some of their repellent :) easy hike tbh
Well marked, great boardwalks, well maintained. Some muddy areas. Great hike!
No bugs yet. A few muddy sections, otherwise good. Beautiful view point at top of Solitaire
Beautiful hidden gem!! Little middy in some spots nothing crazy! Scenery is so beautiful and lots of look out spots.
Gorgeous views. Some ice on the trail. Hiking shoes advised
This time of year, be extremely careful with the ice. I would not suggest doing this trail without spikes and even with spikes there are some very bad spots.
Cool trail, very icy would recommend bring cleats
Awesome snow conditions for snowshoeing. It would have been difficult to walk with just boots. The sun was shining and hardly any wind made it an enjoyable hike.
Totally snowed over so we broke fresh ground the whole way, refreshing and beautiful
My friends fell 6.5 times and it was nice

Nice and easy trail with a slight bit of climb to echo point with lovely vistas from the cliff edge. 
It takes about 2:30 hrs at leisurely pace.
Lovely route around the lake. Some muddy parts but not too bad. Easy going trail with lovely views out across the water.
Loop hike at sunrise. Great trail with mix of terrain and challenges
Not as spectacular as other trails in the area, but was okay.
Great trail and view. Natural trail.
Lake Solitaire Oct 20 2024
Nice relaxing trail! Definitely very easy. The lookout point on Echo Rock is beyond stunning with the fall colours. Loved the boardwalk over the lake!

An easy hike except for the up and down hike to the lookout, which is moderate if dry and potentially hard if rains have been heavy.  The trail crosses the back of some private cottages, as well as some that are owned and available for booking with the Limberlost people.  A great hike with an amazing lookout.

Amazing trail! We hiked in October so the leaves were great. Well travelled on the weekends but if you go during a weekday you’ll have it almost all to yourself. There’s a couple steep inclines/declines so just be aware if it’s wet or rainy
Best trail ever
So crowded it was unbelievable but beautiful trail and great views of the muskoka colours!  This gem has become too popular to really enjoy the hike though.
The last loop around the lake was not accessible (do not access sign)
Has a portapotty for bathrooms, Great views for a free park!
One of the most beautiful fall hikes in Ontario! Stunning foliage views and nice trail conditions! Love the boardwalks and rocky sections :)
Gorgeous trail through the Limberlost forest. Fall leaves spectacular!

Trail is very well maintained and very beautiful. I do not recommend going here on Thanksgiving weekend as there were  far too many people to have a relaxing hike... it felt like more of a field trip. I will definitely come back mid week to fully experience this beautiful property.
Good view of the fall colours around the lake.
Nice views. Easy hike.

Was here in mid October after it rained a few hours overnight- no bugs. Few marshy areas but all easy to navigate through. This hike was surreal. I did it at 830am, as the sun was rising over the tree line. Made for the most spectacular scenery with shimmering crystallized rocks and all colours of leaves glowing around me. The boardwalks and bridges were neat. The lookout point was surreal at this time of year. The hike up to the lookout was fantastic cardio. This hike was great for me on a solo adventure- very safe for other solo hikers as there are cabins dotted all around the lake. On the latter end of my hike, there were a lot of families joining for the smaller trail loops. Great for all sorts for sure, this place is a serious gem of beauty. Lots of parking with back up lots available. All very well marked throughout the experience.
Easy trail. A few muddy spots and steep climbing up/down for 1/2 km to Echo Rock lookout.
Perfect day for it. Fav trail around the region.
Pretty muddy in spots, but thankfully not busy as it can be in the Fall. We went late afternoon on a Tuesday. One of our favourite hikes.
Stunning views at every turn. The landscape feels like a masterpiece, with vibrant skies and peaceful nature all around. A perfect escape that leaves you in awe and wanting more.
Well marked easy-moderate trail.

Had a lovely time hiking in this gorgeous place. There are a few trails with easy access to the lakes where you can enjoy breathtaking fall foliage if you visit during fall season. We completed solitaire trail which goes around the solitaire lake. Trail is well maintained and clean. Since it’s a private property which has many private cottages, you have to pass through the cottage grounds. Seems a little awkward as you go, but as long as you stay quiet while passing through those without interrupting anyone with loud noises, it’s a great place to enjoy. Really grateful for the property management for making this place available to the public without charging for anything, including free parking.
Very pretty trail! Well marked. A bit muddy in some spots so wear boots. Also it’s that time of the year so it’s to be expected.

I saw a number of mixed reviews about this trail and did not know what to expect .
I am 68 and had a knee replacement 4 months ago which was a challenge until recently so keep this in mind with my review 

Yes we started off and passed a number of cottages ( only one you were not allowed to pass through ) . 

The path was flat and easy to walk along until you reach quartz hill where the hill is quite steep but to be honest it was harder for me coming down than going up even with the switchbacks . We were fortunate it was very dry 

We only met a few other travellers until the end of the trail where we met a number of mushroom pickers

To be honest there were not many great lookout point but in the next while I am sure the colours will be magnificent 
The only wildlife we saw was a couple of mergansers  and  a loon far out in the lake 

Yesterday I did the clear and turtle lake e hikes which was not only flatter but to me the views were much better 

Even with my not 100 percent knee we easily completed the trail in 2.25 hours 

Enjoy Martin
Beautiful  colours , lake, trees,lookout
Rainy weekdays are perfect if you need some alone time. Didn’t see a single soul. Trail is well marked and maintained
Beautiful and well taken care of trail.  Great little resting places to stop and take in the views!
Need to sign waiver at parking. There is a bathroom there. Very nice trail around the lake.
Beautiful easy trail - cottages near the start/end of trail, 100m elevation, stunning lookout up top. Couple hikers told us there was a small black bear sighting but we didn’t get to spot any.
Really beautiful trial. A little bit of up hill. But worth it
Beautiful dappled woodland trail.

We were walking along the Solitaire Lake Loop and about 3/4's of the way around, we came across a bear sleeping on a boulder beside the trail. We decided to turn around and go to Echo Rock lookout the other way. We didn't know if he would wake up startled and grumpy! lol
Absolutely beautiful views. I think we might have found a bear cave as well on our hike.
absolutely beautiful and pristine
No bugs no mud no people :) happy first day back to school
Lake Solitaire Sept 1st 2024

Easy trail, minimal elevation, mostly flat. Nice breeze in the canopy with lake views. We went clockwise and the beginning parts were through cabin backyards. Last bit was back on the road which we didn’t prefer.

This is by far, one of my most favourite hikes. It's definitely a decent hike and in the last 1/4 -1/3 of the hike there is quite a lot of elevation change, both up and down. My poles came in handy in that section. There's a wonderfully cool breeze off the lake on hot days. The last 6-7 minutes are on the road back to the parking area. I've done this once, each of the last 3 years and just find it very special.
Lovely trail, easy to get to. Moderate to difficult for a 60 year old in fair shape.
Steep hill :( was hard. Walking in people’s backyards … weird. Otherwise good. Chipmunks are not friendly or welcoming.  Exercise caution with them.
Beautiful hike!
Not the best for biking. Pretty challenging actually. Great hiking trail. Beautiful views.
Trail is marked good, moderately hard at times but worth the climb to the top of the look out! Beautiful!!  Would be gorgeous in the fall!
Beautiful well groomed trails.
Several nice views of Solitare Lake. Trail conditions vary from flat and easy to very muddy.

The trail can be a challenge with mud and after rainy weather. Did get a few solid bug bites. There is a good portion of uphill & downhill slopes that we took caution to since it started raining hard halfway through our Hike. The last leg of the trail takes you back to the main road since there are private cottages. Not as nice of an ending but overall was still great!
Free, you just fill out a waiver! Never seen so many different mushrooms before. There were very little people for a weekend. There's lots to see and the boardwalks by the water were lovely!
Beautiful trail. Great scenery. Bug spray and hiking shoes highly recommended!
Lake, Solitaire, July 6, 2024

Great trails 
Easy to follow
Good walk. Lots of cottages you walk in front of (weird). Flat almost the entire way but the one hill is a doozy. Last leg is on the road unless you add the Turtle Lake loop for another 2km.
Well maintained, fun trail. Quite a few muddy patches but we just received a reasonable amount of rain.  White running shoes not recommended.
But buggy and muddy but not too bad. Views amazing as always

Long trail - not for the faint of heart!

Lots of bugs and very muddy! Coyotes on the trail as well.
Solitaire June 20th 2024
Nice hike on a well maintained trail
Good trail, only one short spot of elevation change. Bugs not to bad on a cooler day in early June. Plenty of resting spots if required.
Lovely, we’ll maintained trail. Lots of very persistent mosquitos though (they will even bite your face!) so be prepared!
Solitaire may 20th 2024
A little mucky but passable and very enjoyable!
Several sections were quite muddy or very icy across the whole width of the trail. First boardwalk has ice across it.
Beautiful trails with the view of the lake Specially, the view from Echo lookout was stunning. Personally, I’m adding it to one of the must do trails during fall and summer.
Great trail, didn’t enjoy having to walk through all the cottages at the beginning but once you get past them, it is an awesome trail! It is icy and muddy right now, so be safe
Beautiful

Such a perfect trail! Lots to see, far from boring and each corner turned provides something new to look at. Took us longer to complete (started at turtle lake) because we stopped to take lots of pictures and take in the views. Recommend 10/10. Can’t wait to come back during another season

This is a beautiful trail which is easy to navigate.  We wore ice cleats and we were glad we did…some sections were icy under light layer of snow, however we saw others without them.   We completed the trail on Turtle Lake first and added this trail afterward.  Highly recommended.
Fabulous. As long as you have crampons on.
Would highly recommend crampons for winter hiking. There were several elevations that were very slippery and difficult to manage. A gorgeous trail though!
Perfect winter weather for a hike.  Some spots were a little icy, but overall good trail.
The trail is quite slick, and very packed.  Would definitely suggest ice grippers of some kind.
Awesome trail!! Must do again o. The spring hidden gem

This is truly a WOW trail !!!
Stunning views in EVERY direction, immaculately clean, and the trail markers are perfectly visible.
This is now one of our favorite trails, definitely coming back again
Nice trail, but muddy and icy.
Trail was muddy with icy sections. It was a beautiful hike.

Unfortunately we were a little crunched for time so we only walked about 1/3 of it and back but it was a really pretty winter trail with pretty views of the lake. We only passed one small group of people, otherwise it was very quiet.
Limberlost - Solitaire Lake trail
There’s muddsy parts this time of the year

Excellent trail around the lake.  Thankfully the leaves had helped it seem less muddy than it is.  Would have loved to explore a couple weeks earlier , when the leaves were changing colours.  Great afternoon on November 3rd , 2023!

Muddy on portions. 
Beautiful lookout but a little challenging terrain to get to it.
Wonderful trail. Well maintained. Few mud sections, but, it's nature! Easy to navigate.
Free parking, bathrooms and tuck shop at the entrance of the trail. Great trail along the water. The last km of the loop is on the road with no shoulder/side walk. A bit muddy but very well kept!
Muddy is some parts but a beautiful fall walk.
Little wet but beautiful
Lots of colorful carpets of leaves!!
Nice trail around lake.  Nice climb to Echo Rock.  Didn’t like the first part that takes you through the front of private cottages.
Very beautiful with one steep section to the echo rock lookout. Lots of boardwalks and points of interest. Muddy in some places but nothing too bad.
Lots of tree roots, but a very pretty view of the lake
Beautiful trail.
Really pretty,lots of shade, a few moderate climbs
This trail is awesome.  Beautiful views, lots of photo ops, and places to rest along the way.
Well-marked trail, begins/ends on a road. Gets wet easily.
We’ll marked trail. Dry with a bit of mud  in spots. Very pretty
Pretty easy trail, a bit of elevation but not too bad. Not too buggy in late August. Not too muddy either!
Good infrastructure, a little bit of mud in a couple of spots but no big deal.
Beautiful trail. A bit marshy/wet in spots but overall a great hike.
Great scenery; lookout is amazing and the trail is so beautiful by the water
Nice shady trail with cool bridges. But I think the elevation was approximately 100m (Not 280m per current description). Great lookout. Saw some loons and falcons! Highly recommend!
You finish on the road .
Easy trail. Beautiful views. Really enjoyable hike.
Pretty but a lot cut through private properties/cottage and had to walk along road to connect back to start
Lovely day lovely day lovely day
Great trail. Very scenic with a beautiful look out point
They recently cleaned up the fallen trees, it has also dried up so less bugs! Great time to hike this trail
Well marked and maintained. Lots of things to see along the way, with the beautiful lake being the feature.
Overall in good condition.  Light long sleeves recommend to avoid mosquitos.  Overall easy hike.
Tons of mosquitoes,but the trail is fun and well groomed.

I hiked this June 20th and it was awesome! I just found it to be one of the best trails I've hiked. Mosquitos were bad enough that I wished I'd put my bug jacket on. it's through forest mostly, so was able to be kept out of the really hot sun. Most of the way you are right at the waters edge. At one point there was such a wonderful breeze coming off the lake! There's a lot of easy areas, but be prepared for moderate also. There are muddy areas but most have a work-around. Lots of boardwalks over really wet areas.
Pretty trail with views of the water and easy to follow signs. Only one steeper uphill/ downhill section otherwise relatively easy. Lots of bugs when the breeze dies down though!

The bugs weren’t as bad as I thought. The breeze from the lake kept them at bay. A beautiful trail, many great spots to just sit and enjoy the view of the lake and the beauty of nature. A gorgeous lookout spot!
Excellent conditions as always at Limberlost
Great hike around Solitaire lake. Some mosquitos in the forest area but nothing too bad.
Beautiful views and an amazing breeze this morning that helped keep the bugs away. So refreshing now to enjoy the beach!
Buggy

Great trail, still slightly wet in places but completed easily in trail running trainers. 

Plenty of blackfly around but to be expected this time of year. 

Steep in places
So peaceful. I hiked at around 8 am and only encountered one other person.  Relatively easy, just a couple of “hills” most could manage. Highly recommend this trail!  Picturesque.

Have hiked this trail several times and it is always great.  With the thaw underway now, the trail is very icy and a bit treacherous.  I would not recommend doing this trail without micro-spikes at the moment
A bit icy but beautiful

An amazing, beautiful trail!! Starting from the parking lot, we hopped right on the trailhead which adds about another 1km to this loop. And it's definitely worth it...so very pretty!! The main trail (Solitaire Lake Loop) tours you around the lake, up and down you'll go, passing by and under giant granite and quartz boulders, photo-ops next to frozen waterfalls, amazing cliff views, wee cabins for respite, private cottages for inspiration...and very low human traffic. We explored this trail on the first day of spring, it was in full sparkle-magic-mode, and I couldn't have been more grateful. We were with our favourite adventure partner and pups...definitely check this trail out. Perfect Muskoka landscape. We cannot wait to come back in the summer for some sweet dives in the lake!!
Covered in snow but even better because of it. Absolutely love this trail.
Beautiful sunny day!
Very nice winter trail! Wear crampons!
Snowshoes not needed unless you are breaking trail after a snowfall.

Trail was great, a bit muddy and slippery as the snow was melting due to warmer weather temperatures. Free of charge as long as you register your vehicle. I am looking forward to exploring more trails here in the near future!

Easy but very pretty trail.  We  hiked this trail with a few inches of snow on the ground.  Not sure I would like it in the summer as presumably all of the cottages along the way would  be occupied….would feel like I was intruding.  Plenty of other wonderful trails here to hike though.
Lots of sun; bit of ice. Great hike! Great views!

I loved this trail but couldn’t 5 star it because of the cottages around the lake. Off season is quiet but I imagine during the summer season, it would be weird hiking through cottage properties with people there.
Lovely spot

Parts of the trail are through private cottages, couple great views through the trees. 

Well maintained trail.

Got here at 9am Oct 9, only a couple cars. Wonderful hike, gorgeous fall colours and fairly dry conditions considering the rain.
Took 2 hours with a couple photo stops, the lookout is beautiful.
It was cold and wet today but didn’t stop anyone! Trails were very busy. Beautiful loop!
Nice variety of terrain & scenic. Fairly quiet compared to Algonquin which was nice. Moderate trail

We hiked in from the small parking area at the road to Echo Rock - a very pleasant trail with a couple of boardwalks; switchbacks up to the Rock. This is backward to the usual direction the trail is hiked.  After a stop at Echo Rock we visited the Quartz Deposit - amazing.  Then we elected to return via an alternate route through the forest, past apple orchard.  BUT we missed the beginning of that trail & instead ended up on a beautiful wide downhill slope (probably a ski trail) that brought us out due west at a eutrophic lake, not near our car where we should have been. After discerning we were not in in proper location, we had to back track uphill to the quartz deposit, and then out on the main trail.  Sigh.  It was a much longer hike than we had planned & getting off track kind of spoiled it.  A posted sign to the start of the return trail from near the quartz deposit would be a great improvement!
Beautiful hike, full fall colours! Full loop may be difficult for people with mobility issues. Half way point there is an up hill and down. Great look out at the top.
Was good. Not too muddy :) rough just from roots and stuff. No strollers would make it. Saw lots of doggies!
Cute trail hike with lots of little bridges!

The trail is amazing!!!  Some people had said it was not well marked. I get that, there are signs when you need them the most, but they are not intuitive. BUT at least the trail follows the lake so if you’re not sure, as long as the lake is to your right, you’re on the trail! There is a sign that says Quartz Deposit and another on saying Echo Rock. These are not suggestions of fun things to do, they are trail markers. So when you see them, go where they say :). Otherwise you’ll be in a bit of a mess!  Also, the elevation gain says something like 283m and there was mention of a climb up the rock. The whole 283 isn’t the rock climb :). It is quite a scramble, but not hard. Places are muddy but manageable. Bring proper waterproof footwear and your insect repellent and you’ll be fine. All in all, amazing hike!
